name: System R1
description: System R with a fixed, information-based tie-break: tied ranks go to the higher 6-month strength (rs126), then alphabetical symbol (engine.rank_desc). Before this, np.argsort broke ties in an order that changed with the numpy version, so R's results were partly tie luck. Chosen by a rule fixed beforehand: beat the tie-seed range (8 random tie orders x 5 calendars) on day-1 and day-15 starts; highest growth among those that do. Only rs126 qualified: 71.2% / 71.2% of calendar years vs seed ranges 69.0-70.8% / 68.9-70.5% (audit a69, a71). Adopted on the owner's instruction (17 Oct 2026).
